④ Fable 5 xhigh (Claude Code · goal mode)

Stack: hand-written raw Three.js + custom GLSL shaders + UnrealBloom, parchment retro-chart, 14 cities.
⏱ ~27m build | 💰 ~$30 | 📦 2,199 lines.
